Professional Overview

Professional Profile

A disciplined healthcare professional with a rigorous approach to pharmacy operations, patient guidance, and pharmaceutical inventory control.

Muhammad Mohsin Saleem
Pharmacy Technician / Pharmacy Assistant
Karachi, Pakistan

Muhammad Mohsin Saleem is a dedicated Pharmacy Technician / Pharmacy Assistant based in Karachi, Pakistan, offering 5 years of practical experience across hospital and retail pharmacy environments.

His professional foundation includes key roles at Medask Pharmacy (CMH Malir Cantt, Karachi), Asma Medical Store (Malir, Karachi), and Noor Medical Store (Karachi). He has developed extensive hands-on proficiency in prescription dispensing support under pharmacist oversight, OPD counter management, and patient counseling on dosage timing and medicine storage.

Clinical Focus: Strictly adhering to pharmaceutical compliance, expiry monitoring via FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) rotation, cold-chain temperature regulation for sensitive medicines, and efficient POS counter billing.
